author: Inside Edition
description: Paul Caneiro faced sentencing for murdering his brother, his brother's wife and their two children. The 59-year-old was found guilty of shooting his brother Keith after Paul was caught stealing from the family businesses. Then Paul stabbed his brother's wife, Jennifer and their two young children Sophia and Jesse. Paul also set his brother's $2 million New Jersey home ablaze. Paul was sentenced to life with no possibility of parole.
title: Man Sentenced To Life Without Parole For Killing His Brother, Brother's Wife And Their 2 Children

author: Inside Edition
description: A tornado destroyed everything in its path. The twister headed for the home of Mary and Andy Sloat. The powerful EF-4 tornado brought winds topping 200 miles per hour, decimating their home, and they were buried alive in their cellar. When first responders arrived, there was no sign of the family. The family's 3-year-old pet goats, Percy and Penny, not only survived the hellscape, they also stood over the cellar and started bleating as if to pinpoint the rescuers to the trapped family. The family was saved.
title: Hero Goats Help Lead Rescuers To Trapped Family During Tornado

author: Inside Edition
description: Melanie Smith listed an old iPhone for sale on Facebook Marketplace and what followed, she says, was three years of stalking. Smith says she received thousands of text messages. Then came gifts sent to her parents' house. Smith filed police reports but says cops did very little to help, a claim police deny. One night, the man showed up at her parents' home. Michal Pacek was arrested later that morning and charged with harassment and stalking. He was deemed mentally unfit to proceed with the case. The charges were dropped and he was released. Smith says he is still harassing her.
title: Woman Says Man Has Been Harassing Her For Years After Facebook Marketplace Listing

author: Inside Edition
description: Police in San Diego are still trying to make sense of a shooting at an Islamic Center, where they say 2 teenage suspects killed 3 men outside the building. Police say the suspects were 17 and 18 years old and who were later found dead from what investigators say were self-inflicted gunshot wounds. Police say earlier they received a call from a mother who said she believed her son was suicidal. Inside Edition Digital’s Mara Montalbano has more.
title: 3 Killed Outside Islamic Center In San Diego, 2 Suspects Later Found Dead

author: Inside Edition
description: Several unusual, colorful piggy banks have popped up on the beaches in Texas. Jace Tunnell says he first noticed them last year, and now they're quickly multiplying. So far, over 60 have been found, and now the Harte Research Institute team has come up with theories about where they've come from. These are just one of many unusual things the marine biologist has found throughout his career. Inside Edition Digital's Andrea Swindall has more.
title: Over 60 Piggy Banks Found on Texas Beach
